name: kid-games
description: 爸爸的游戏乐园 / 星港 — a static, offline-capable game hall for one kid's iPad (home-screen web app).

scripts.build: node tools/check-registry.mjs && node tools/check-content.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/smoke/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: node tools/check-registry.mjs && node tools/check-content.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vitest run
